parts.label: (i)
parts.text: The random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{B}(300, 0.01)$. Use a Poisson approximation to find $\text{P}(2 < X < 6)$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: The random variable $Y$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(\lambda)$, and $\text{P}(Y = 0) = \text{P}(Y = 2)$. Find $\lambda$.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: The random variable $Z$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(5.2)$ and it is given that $\text{P}(Z = n) < \text{P}(Z = n + 1)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Hence or otherwise find the largest possible value of $n$.
